readiness.hed: Sun and a high near 67 this afternoon. Frost advisory from 1 a.m. to 9 a.m. Monday, low around 35.
readiness.insight: A frost advisory covers portions of central and northern Virginia from 1 a.m. to 9 a.m. Monday. The National Weather Service says temperatures as low as 33 can put frost on tender plants, and uncovered plants may be killed. This afternoon is sunny, a high near 67, southeast wind around 2 mph. Tonight is clear, then areas of frost and patchy fog, with a low around 35.
actions: Monday morning frost until 9 a.m., then sun and a high near 71
